title: Crispy Bacon Ukrainian Dumplings
description: A hearty and savory Eastern European-inspired dish featuring crispy bacon and tender Ukrainian-style dumplings. This comforting meal is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the Ukrainian-style dumpling wrappers according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, cook the crisp bacon over medium heat until crispy. Remove the bacon from the skillet, leaving the drippings behind.
Add the ground pork to the skillet and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until translucent.
Add the cooked dumpling wrappers to the skillet and stir to combine with the pork and onion mixture.
Season the dumpling mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Add the cooked bacon back into the skillet and stir to combine.
Serve the crispy bacon Ukrainian dumplings hot, garnished with additional crispy bacon if desired.
